color.note: Semantic tokens first (use these), then the kitty palette, then the raw ramps. Winter is the light theme, Polar night the dark. Every text/background pair named in a usage note passes WCAG AA in both themes.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Desktop and full-screen backdrops (installer, login card backdrop, bar-less areas).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Window and page background: every app, the installer card, the terminal chrome.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs, popovers, notifications, the launcher, list rows on hover.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: the top bar, toggle/progress tracks, code blocks, sidebar.

tokens.name: frost
tokens.usage: Frost surfaces (with backdrop blur-lg): top bar, launcher, OSD, lock screen card. Only over wallpaper, never over text-heavy windows.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modal dialogs.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: dividers, card outlines, unfocused window borders. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control boundaries (inputs, checkboxes, radios, toggle off). 3:1 on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, on ground, surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and accent-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: help text, metadata, unselected tabs. On every ground/surface token.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, timestamps, disabled-looking-but-readable captions. 4.5:1 on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and icons only (exempt from contrast by WCAG 1.4.3). Pair with a disabled control, never with live text.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on an ink-coloured fill (tooltips).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Amber eyes. Primary button fill, checked controls, active workspace, focused window border, progress fill.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button active/pressed.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills. Always dark charcoal; never white on amber.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Amber used as text or a thin icon (links, the selected step label) on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected list rows and selected app tiles, behind ink text.

tokens.name: accent-edge
tokens.usage: Amber as a boundary (3:1 on every surface): the 1px edge of accent fills in the light theme, the focused window border, the active workspace underline.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring colour. 2px solid ring, 2px offset; 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection background, behind ink.

tokens.name: warm
tokens.usage: Summer coat. Warm secondary text and icons (avatars' initials, tags). On surface and warm-soft.

tokens.name: warm-soft
tokens.usage: Warm tint: avatar discs, category tags, the welcome card's side panel.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons (always with a check icon or word). On surface, surface-raised and success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success banner and toast ground.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons (cloudberry): always with the warning triangle. On surface and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning banner ground.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text, icons, error input border, destructive button fill (with on-error).

tokens.name: error-soft
tokens.usage: Error banner and error toast ground.

tokens.name: on-error
tokens.usage: Text on an error fill (destructive button).

tokens.name: error-hover
tokens.usage: Destructive button hover.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info text and icons (ice). On surface and info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info banner ground.

tokens.name: aurora-1
tokens.usage: Aurora gradient stop 1 (green). Welcome, splash, wallpapers only.

tokens.name: aurora-2
tokens.usage: Aurora gradient stop 2 (teal).

tokens.name: aurora-3
tokens.usage: Aurora gradient stop 3 (ice). The gradient always fades into ground.

tokens.name: term-background
tokens.usage: kitty background.

tokens.name: term-foreground
tokens.usage: kitty foreground; 4.5:1+ on term-background.

tokens.name: term-cursor
tokens.usage: Block cursor (amber).

tokens.name: term-cursor-text-color
tokens.usage: Glyph under the cursor.

tokens.name: term-selection-background
tokens.usage: Selected text background.

tokens.name: term-selection-foreground
tokens.usage: Selected text.

tokens.name: ansi-0
tokens.usage: ANSI color0 (black). Dark theme: near the background by design (it IS the black); never used for text.

tokens.name: ansi-1
tokens.usage: ANSI color1 (red). 4.5:1+ on term-background in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-2
tokens.usage: ANSI color2 (green). 4.5:1+ on term-background in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-3
tokens.usage: ANSI color3 (yellow). 4.5:1+ on term-background in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-4
tokens.usage: ANSI color4 (blue). 4.5:1+ on term-background in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-5
tokens.usage: ANSI color5 (magenta). 4.5:1+ on term-background in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-6
tokens.usage: ANSI color6 (cyan). 4.5:1+ on term-background in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-7
tokens.usage: ANSI color7 (white). Light theme: mid grey, 4.5:1 on the light background.

tokens.name: ansi-8
tokens.usage: ANSI color8 (bright-black). 4.5:1+ on term-background in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-9
tokens.usage: ANSI color9 (bright-red). 4.5:1+ on term-background in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-10
tokens.usage: ANSI color10 (bright-green). 4.5:1+ on term-background in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-11
tokens.usage: ANSI color11 (bright-yellow). 4.5:1+ on term-background in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-12
tokens.usage: ANSI color12 (bright-blue). 4.5:1+ on term-background in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-13
tokens.usage: ANSI color13 (bright-magenta). 4.5:1+ on term-background in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-14
tokens.usage: ANSI color14 (bright-cyan). 4.5:1+ on term-background in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-15
tokens.usage: ANSI color15 (bright-white). Light theme: a dark slate so 'bright white' emphasis stays readable.

families.sans: Figtree, "Noto Sans", "Noto Sans Hebrew", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Figtree (SIL OFL). Tight tracking only at display sizes.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: Login and lock-screen clock only. Tabular figures.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Installer welcome and Done screens; boot splash wordmark size.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: One per installer step and per dialog-sized page.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: List-row and card titles, option labels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Everything on this disk will be replaced by Arctic Linux.
styles.usage: Default UI text and help text.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text; button labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, bar items, compact buttons.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Tiny uppercase tags above titles. Use sparingly.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: JetBrains Mono (SIL OFL). Terminal, code, keyboard hints, GRUB.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code and commands in help text.

spacing.note: 4px base. Use the steps; never in-between values.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Hairline nudges: badge padding, icon optical offsets.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in dense rows; step-dot gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tiling window gap (inner and outer), gap inside controls, icon-to-label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding, list-row vertical padding, bar side padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and toast padding, field-to-field gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a step.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Installer content padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between title block and content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Installer page margins, login card spacing.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Splash and welcome whitespace.

radius.note: Soft and rounded like the fox — never sharp, never fully bubbly except pills.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkbox, kbd chip, tooltip tail-less corners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small tags, menu items inside a menu.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, dropdowns, list rows, tiled windows (Mango border_radius 10).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, toasts, notifications, app tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, launcher, installer window, login card.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills: toggles, workspace dots, OSD, avatars, progress bars.

shadow.note: Soft, cool and low. Dark theme leans on a 1px light edge instead of heavier shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards, app tiles, selected rows.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, dropdown lists, toasts, notifications, tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the launcher, the installer window, the login card.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px gap in the surface colour, then 2px of solid amber (box-shadow follows the radius). Qt/GTK: 2px outline, 2px offset, focus colour.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, card outlines, control borders (line-strong).

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width and offset.

tokens.name: border-window
tokens.usage: Tiled window border: accent-edge when focused, line when not.

blur.note: Frost surfaces. Always paired with the frost colour.

tokens.name: blur-md
tokens.usage: OSD and tooltips over wallpaper.

tokens.name: blur-lg
tokens.usage: Top bar, launcher, lock and login card.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum pointer target (hit area) anywhere; 44px on touch screens.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact controls in the bar and dense tables (hit area still padded to 32px).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, input, dropdown height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Installer Back/Next, login password field.

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: Top bar height.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Inline icons, bar icons.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and list rows.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: App tiles in lists; 48px in the launcher grid.

duration.note: Motion is short and quiet. Under prefers-reduced-motion every duration becomes 0ms except fades, which stay at duration-fast.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, focus ring, checkbox tick.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Toggles, dropdown open, toast in, tiling window move.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Dialogs, launcher, installer step transition (fade + 8px slide).

tokens.name: duration-ambient
tokens.usage: Splash breathing and fetch animation loop. Stops under reduced motion.

easing.note: Standard for most; enter decelerates, exit accelerates.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Most UI transitions.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Things arriving: dialogs, toasts, notifications.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Things leaving.

tokens.name: ease-ambient
tokens.usage: Looping ambient motion (splash breathing).
